Very good staff, bad champagne.
Jun 2026 • Family
I took my group of five here. Spent a lot of money. It’s an expensive place on the grounds of the Intercon. We ordered their signature, a seafood platter for a starter. They should have warned us that it would take forever to arrive and needless to say, they weren’t busy. The unforgivable is that I ordered a bottle of champagne to accompany it, but they did not chill it. They have my mother-in-law the honor of tasting it, and not knowing, said it was fine. Staff should have known or they should have but in a quick chiller. I expressed displeasure and they comped dessert, but still…far from a perfect evening and very expensive. Staff wax great though!

Outstanding food, service & ambiance
Nov 2025 • Family
Simply outstanding! It’s hard to put into words how truly amazing both experiences I’ve had when visiting Lava at the Intercontinental Phu Quoc have truly been. The food is absolutely exquisite. The service is outstanding with warm, friendly and loving hospitality displayed throughout your entire experience. We celebrated my mother‘s 72nd birthday here, and the team went above and beyond to make it a night that was truly unforgettable and magical. Unfortunately, my second visit was a solo trip as my mom was very ill, but I will always come back here as it was one of her favorite destinations, and such a special memory that we made together. A huge thank you to the entire team. They say food is for nourishment, but not only of the body. Food nourishes, our mind, our soul and our spirit. Lava and the outstanding team here made this one of the most memorable dining experiences I’ve ever had in my life.
